## State transition

Phase 0.75 completed its pinned upstream audits, evidence-preserving harness, SiRA
adapter, regulation-decision provenance retrofit, and locked EXP-0001 protocol. The
completed ledger passed independent spec-conformance review and the repository gate.
Phase 1 is now the one active plan.

## Scientific boundary

EXP-0001 remains exactly SiRA simulative versus matched reactive behavior. It has no
harness-to-kernel condition or internalization claim, and no run has occurred. The
planned/deferred RQ-H2K track may consume trace-completeness and lineage evidence only;
that infrastructure record cannot affect EXP-0001 validity, metrics, or outcome.

## Execution boundary

Paid compute, prototype execution, benchmark execution, training, and cloud mutation
remain false. The only next eligible profile is `PLAN-EXP0001-SMOKE`, a one-pair
reactive/simulative infrastructure smoke with interpretation disabled. Its proposed
USD 4.00 cap is not authorization.

## Next gate

The next possible T07 authorization is the bounded Lambda Gate L1 read-only inventory.
It cannot launch a host. After separate host and workload qualification gates succeed,
a later live-pair authorization must name the exact smoke plan, Lambda host plan,
OpenAI and the `gpt-4o-2024-11-20` substitution, provider and API cost caps, wall
limits, and container/provider cleanup. T07 must pass identity, command-diff,
finite-budget, artifact-ownership, secret, and cleanup preflight before any live action.

## T07 infrastructure update — design only

The Mac-local Docker Desktop and Colima/Lima paths are now terminal rejected
infrastructure alternatives. The project selected a short-lived x86_64 Lambda
On-Demand Cloud host as T07's planned substrate, with no persistent Lambda filesystem
and provider-API termination as the billing boundary.

This selection is not an experiment run or cloud authorization. The next possible
action is a separately authorized, eight-GET, redacted Lambda inventory. Host
qualification, the Playwright/SiRA image probes, the live reactive/simulative pair,
paid compute, model calls, browser actions, and interpretation all remain unauthorized.
The inventory is not complete until its redacted artifact is hash-verified in the
approved MacBook archive; host qualification also needs authenticated first-contact
SSH host-key trust.
No Lambda account was queried and no secret, instance, container, browser, model, or
SiRA condition was accessed or executed for this update.
